params.title: Takeaways
params.lede: Five findings that survive every methodology check.

cards.label: Headline AUC
cards.body: Histone variant generalizes at AUC 0.848 ± 0.040 with FLAIR shape features alone. Five seeds, std < 0.05, leak-free site-mixed eval.

cards.label: Survivors
cards.body: OLIG2 (0.808) and PIK3CA (0.791) — both already leak-free. Histone within-UCSF is 0.685 leak-free.

cards.label: Leakage discovery
cards.body: Original mi_top20 LOOCV numbers were inflated by 0.09–0.20. TP53 and ATRX collapse to chance once leakage is removed.

cards.label: Honest ceiling
cards.body: AUC 0.95 target was never realistic. Site-mixed ~0.85, within-UCSF ~0.70 for the strongest gene.

callout.text: Path forward: more data, not more architectures; site variety in the training set; per-fold feature selection by default.
